title: Mixed Finite Elements for Geometrically Exact Beams using Discontinuous Rotations and Discrete Curvature
summary: We propose a novel mixed finite-element formulation for geometrically exact (Simo--Reissner) beams that introduces the moment vector as additional independent field. The specific mixed form allows for an element-local, discontinuous approximation of rotations, which is key to a simple and efficient discretization framework. The concept of discrete curvature provides a mathematically consistent treatment of rotation discontinuities.
